# counterfactual-bias-probe

> Counterfactual bias probes: expand templates over paired attribute values, score each prompt through an injected scorer and report per-group gaps Python package `trysac-counterfactual-bias-probe`, import name `counterfactual_bias_probe`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
